name: town-negative
description: The negative baseline for the town inventory redesign (borg-zoo#81): borg-rs with no store interaction at all (town-negative), against the same build trading normally (normal). Both arms are the same specimen, so the comparison stays inside one workflow run (RULES 7). A pilot on classes-18; classes-1800 follows only if the pilot reads well. Endpoint, prespecified in borg-zoo#81: per class, paired on the seed, milestones[].level at 50% and 100% of the cap and final.max_depth; secondary milestones[].gold, first_turn_at_depth, final.keys and the death split. A calibration of trade and the stash combined, not a strategy: no improvement is claimed.
